why: The oil. Six of this deck's lands are counted as coloured sources and CANNOT PAY A COLOURED COST ON CURVE: their only coloured mode costs extra mana on top of the tap. Excluding them, every colour is short -- white 18 against a target of 22, blue 18 against 22, black 25 against 36 -- where the headline figures read 24/24/31 and only black looked wrong. The four cut here have no compensating utility; Talon Gates of Madara phases out a creature and Darkwater Catacombs is a real filter once a land is down, so both stay. The three adds are UNTAPPED DUALS, each covering two colours, plus a Swamp for the fourth slot. A first attempt at this went the other way -- cutting the gated lands for basics -- and mana-fit refused it: those lands ARE counted for all three colours, so cutting them without replacing the fixing made every gap worse.
